summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for trace-based cache simulation benchmarking with closed-loop replay methodology. It does not semantically match any existing skill (which cover checkpoint configuration, model evaluation, and fault tolerance). Peer candidates (adaptive queue balancing, algorithm selection, risk assessment) are related but operate at different stages (runtime_optimization, design_decision, design_validation) and task families (cache_tuning, cache_optimization, risk_assessment vs. cache_benchmarking). The candidate's focus on reproducible performance testing via trace replay isolation is a separate capability from algorithm selection or adaptive tuning. Support evidence confirms the methodology is established in literature (section 4 Design and implementation). No conflicts detected.
